mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0), supply chain disruptions and manufacturing contraction pressure corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC for condition falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months reflects robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that typically triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), elevated borrowing costs reduce equity valuations and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5, or Rank IC for condition falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
